prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1392; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the parking lot collision described in your insured's claim file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Our client has been advised to limit discussion of the incident and treatment with anyone other than counsel.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified declarations page and confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm whether the insured has reported the loss to any other carrier.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, vehicle telematics, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any physical components of the vehicles involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or overwriting of such material until this matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
